price.text_en: Listed price USD 599.99 (confirm officially at purchase)

daily_dd.text_ja: 日次損失制限なし。最大損失とリスク上限は別。
daily_dd.text_en: No daily loss limit. Maximum loss and risk caps separate.

max_dd.text_ja: 残高最高値から初期資金6%相当額のトレーリング、初期資金で下限固定。出金後の残存下限と新周期利益による追随に注意。
max_dd.text_en: Peak balance minus 6% of initial capital, trailing and locking at initial capital. Check remaining floor after payout and trailing with new-cycle profit.

refund_after_pass.text_ja: 費用返還なし。
refund_after_pass.text_en: No fee return.

funded_profit_target.text_ja: 利益目標なし。出金には別の利益条件。
funded_profit_target.text_en: No profit target; separate profit conditions for payout.

ea.text_ja: MT4/MT5は追加料金と独自戦略条件。SL/TPやロット計算だけのツールもEA扱い。

sources.evidence_scope: Stellar Instant EA eligibility and fee gap

ea.text_en: MT4/MT5: additional fee and proprietary-strategy conditions. Tools limited to SL/TP or lot calculation also count as EAs.

ip.text_ja: 共有IP/デバイス/VPSを協調・回避・非独立取引に使うことは禁止。家族で同じIPという理由だけの一律禁止ではない。
ip.text_en: Shared IPs/devices/VPS must not enable coordination, evasion or non-independent trading. Sharing an IP within a family is not automatically prohibited by itself.

minimum_profit_days.text_ja: 最低取引日数なし。出金の時刻・経過日数・利益条件は別途適用。
minimum_profit_days.text_en: No minimum trading days. Payout timing, elapsed-day and profit conditions still apply.

profit_share.text_ja: Tier1・2は70%、Tier3以降80%。上位移行条件は別。
profit_share.text_en: Tiers 1–2: 70%; tier 3 onward: 80%. Advancement conditions separate.

payout_interval.text_ja: 日末5%成長でOn-Demand資格、または14日周期で1%以上成長。資格は着金時間ではない。
payout_interval.text_en: On-Demand eligibility at 5% end-of-day growth, or a 14-day cycle with ≥1% growth. Eligibility is not receipt time.

consistency.text_ja: 一貫性ルールなし。Quick Strike等の取引規則は別。
consistency.text_en: No consistency rule; trading rules such as Quick Strike are separate.

special_rules.title: Profit share from short-duration trades
special_rules.text: Profit from short winning trades / profit from all winning trades: warning at 20%, stage-specific sanctions at ≥30%. Not average holding time. Check treatment of exactly 30 seconds in official text.

minimum_profit_days.text_en: 3Day option: three profitable days, each ≥1%. Separate from ordinary trading-day requirements.

profit_share.text_ja: Standard80%、3利益日60%、On-Demand90%。有料95%オプションは別。
profit_share.text_en: Standard 80%, 3 profitable days 60%, On-Demand 90%. Paid 95% option separate.

consistency.text_ja: On-Demandのみ最高利益日が累計利益40%以下、2%成長が必要。Standardには適用しない。
consistency.text_en: On-Demand only: best day ≤40% of cumulative profit and 2% growth required. Not applied to Standard.

special_rules.title: Profit share from short-duration trades
special_rules.text: Profit from short winning trades / profit from all winning trades: warning at 20%, stage-specific sanctions at ≥30%. Not average holding time. Check treatment of exactly 30 seconds in official text.
